resources.string: SafeMobile calculates SHA-256 and MD5 hashes on this device and checks them against definitions stored locally. Local scans do not upload files or hashes. Ads use Google Mobile Ads network services only when permitted by your privacy choices and connectivity. Core scan functions work without a network. Installed-app visibility and all-files access are sensitive Android permissions and may require Google Play review.
Checks readable installed APKs against locally stored definitions and reviews files you select. Detection is limited by operating-system access and the definitions installed on this device.
Scan a selected APK or file
Optional monitoring of the public Downloads folder. Android 11+ requires the user to grant all-files access in Settings; Google Play approval is not guaranteed.
Monitoring is opt-in and can be stopped by the user.
